name: HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT
description: The interface table HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT stores information for trees and load into FND_TREE, FND_TREE_TL, FND_TREE_VERSION and FND_TREE_VERSION_TL tables.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_HIERARCHIES_INT interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for Import

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates action entered by user

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for this party

columns.name: LANG_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.description: The purpose of this flag is to identify the row that will be responsible to perform update/insert on the _B table in the fusion schema. If the value is 'Y', the row will be used to Perform insert/update in _B table.Create rows in _TL table for languages that are enabled in fusion but have no data in the interface table.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_ID

columns.name: TREE_LABEL_ID

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
